text: And, behold, there came{H935} a man{H376} of God{H430} out of Judah{H3063} by the word{H1697} of Jehovah{H3068} unto Beth-el:{H1008} and Jeroboam{H3379} was standing{H5975} by the altar{H4196} to burn incense.{H6999}

And the king{H4428} said{H1696} unto the man{H376} of God,{H430} Come{H935} home{H1004} with me, and refresh{H5582} thyself, and I will give{H5414} thee a reward.{H4991}

And he said,{H559} I may{H3201} not return{H7725} with thee, nor go in{H935} with thee; neither will I eat{H398} bread{H3899} nor drink{H8354} water{H4325} with thee in this place:{H4725}
